statements.subject: client
statements.description: When Carol wishes to send an INVITE to "bob@biloxi.com", her UA SHOULD initiate a TLS connection with the biloxi proxy directly (using the mechanism described in [4] to determine how to best to reach the given Request-URI).
actions: Initiate TLS connection with biloxi proxy directly using Request-URI resolution mechanism

statements.subject: client
statements.description: When her UA receives a certificate from the biloxi proxy, it SHOULD be verified normally before she passes her INVITE across the TLS connection.
actions: Pass INVITE across TLS connection only after successful verification

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The biloxi proxy MAY also have a strict policy that precludes it from even bothering to challenge requests that do not have biloxi.com in the "domainname" portion of the From header field - it treats these users as unauthenticated.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Carol SHOULD then establish a TCP connection with the designated address and send a new INVITE with a Request-URI containing the received contact address (recomputing the signature in the body as the request is readied).
statements.post_cond: tcp_connection.established = true & new_INVITE.sent = true & signature.recomputed = true
actions: Establish TCP connection with designated contact address
Send new INVITE with Request-URI set to received contact address
